Meta.title: Photnoo — Professional photo delivery
Meta.description: Deliver galleries to your clients with a private link, a password and proof of every download.

Hero.title: One Workflow, Every Step Covered.
Hero.subtitle: PHOTNOO simplifies every stage of the photographer journey — from booking a client to delivering the final gallery.

Engine.title: Engine
Engine.subtitle: From client galleries to websites and print sales, PHOTNOO gives photographers everything they need to deliver work professionally and grow their business.
Engine.mockupAlt: The Photnoo photographer dashboard: quick actions, clients, active galleries, downloads, storage and recent galleries.

Workflow.title: Workflow
Workflow.subtitle: simplifies every stage of the photographer journey — from booking a client to delivering the final gallery.

Plans.title: Pricing
Plans.subtitle: Start with the plan that fits your workflow and upgrade as your business grows.

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: Perfect for freelancers starting their photography business.

growth.name: Growth
growth.description: Designed for growing photographers with increasing client work.

studio.name: Studio
studio.description: Built for professional studios managing multiple projects.

Why.title: Why
Why.body: Built around the real needs of modern photographers, PHOTNOO combines professional delivery, secure sharing, and business tools into one seamless platform — helping you impress clients, streamline your workflow, and grow your photography business.
